title: Josee Bendaaa-Guerrero Asociados
description: guybendana.com Guy José Bendaña-Guerrero & Asociados (roots to 1907, Managua, Nicaragua) is the leading intellectual-property boutique in Nicaragua, specializing in trademarks, patents, industrial designs, copyright, plant varieties and anti-counterfeiting, plus corporate law, regulatory (sanitary registrations) and litigation. It traces its lineage over 100 years through three legal dynasties — founders Henry Caldera & Henry Caldera-Pallais (who secured Nicaragua's first Trademark Law in 1907 and co-founded ASIPI in 1964), then the Caldera generation, and since 1985 Dr. Guy José Bendaña-Guerrero (a former judge, law professor, author and ex-president of ANIPI) alongside his wife Blanca Aragón de Bendaña and their son Julián. Recognized as Nicaragua's top IP firm by Chambers and Partners, Legal 500 and World Trademark Review 1000, it serves global pharmaceutical, technology, fashion and consumer-goods clients from its Bolonia district office in Managua.
